Old Synagogue of Hechingen

Former Synagogue · Hechingen, Germany

The Old Synagogue of Hechingen stands at Goldschmiedstraße 20. The Jewish community built it in 1767, replacing an earlier building used for worship. During the November pogrom of 1938, the interior was desecrated, but the closely surrounded structure was not burned. The Initiative Hechinger Synagoge has cared for the building since 1979, and it reopened in 1986 after renovation. It now functions as a memorial, cultural centre, exhibition venue, and place for interreligious dialogue, rather than as an active synagogue.
